entries.title: Terraria

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC with current patch and optional mods

primary.why: Terraria released first on Windows and later reached console, handheld, mobile, Linux, macOS, Switch, and Stadia. Windows is the best archive route because it has the strongest update, mod, Workshop, settings, and capture ceiling, while several legacy console/handheld/mobile versions lag or are discontinued.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version through Steam or GOG. Confirm the latest patch and mod/Workshop state before capture.
